caption: The drawing depicts a metallic object consisting of a central, vertically oriented figure with a geometric shape, resembling a combination of a circular and a diamond-shaped form at the top, and a round hole near its uppermost section. Below this shape is a horizontal bar with three rings attached, from which three long, thin, pointed rods or pins hang vertically. The object is rendered in shades of grey and black, positioned centrally on a plain, off-white or light beige background. There is a small ruler in the lower left corner marked in inches, ranging from 0 to 3, and a signature reading "Holger Hansson" appears in the lower right corner. The composition is simple, with the object being the only element in the center of the page.
title: Skewers and Holder
